title: BELT KEYS: PICK, USE AND KEYCAPS
why: His orders of 2026-10-13: "U = next grenade, G = throw it / J = next heal, H = use it", number keys 5 to 9 as instant keys that leave the gun equipped, and button glyphs shown in context. U picks the next grenade and G throws the pick; the new J picks the next heal (rebindable, in the FIGHT list of the key screen) and tap H uses the picked heal instead of the cheapest one; with no J pressed the pick is the cheapest heal that helps, as before. In a raid the keys 5 and 6 throw the grenade on that key at once, 7 and 8 use the heal on that key at once, and 9 slots a plate, and the gun stays in the hands every time without moving the G or H pick. A click on a grenade or heal key picks it. Small keycaps on the belt say which key acts where right now: G on the grenade G throws and U on the other, H on the heal H uses and J on the other, HOLD H on the plate, F on the gun F brings up next, and R on the gun in hand when its magazine is empty and there are rounds to load. They print the keys as set and, on a controller, the pad button where the pad has one. The hover cards, the controls list, the compact list, the rules card and the pause key line say the same.
now: Keys 5 to 9 now use their belt item at once with the gun still in hand, U and J pick the next grenade and heal, and keycaps on the belt show which key does what.
